attributes.mlflow.spanInputs: {"question": "What happens if my card payment fails?"}
attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs: "If a card payment fails, Acme Cloud retries it automatically 3 times over 7 days. If the third attempt also fails, your workspace is downgraded to the Free plan. No data is deleted, so your content stays intact.\n\nTo avoid a downgrade, update your card details or billing information as soon as you get a failed-payment notice, before the retries run out. You can change the billing contact email at Settings → Billing → Billing contact, and download past invoices from Settings → Billing → Invoices."
